description: Fires when the rate of UNVERIFIED chunks exceeds 100 per hour. Usually signals an ingest gap, a corpus reorg, or hostile insertion that bypassed the indexed corpus.
query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend sources = parse_json(sources_s)
| mv-expand source = sources
| where source.verification_outcome == "UNVERIFIED"
| summarize unverified_count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where unverified_count > 100
